correctness.rationale: Independently enumerated all 30 independent Petersen triples, then 30 seven-element complementary facets and all 790 nonempty faces. f-vector (10,45,120,210,240,135,30). Reconstructed sequential-vertex Morse matching: 390 disjoint Hasse pairs, one critical 0-simplex and nine critical 4-simplices, with complete topological sort of the oriented 3,510 covers. Gives wedge^9 S^4; purity dimension six and nonzero H4 then obstruct shellability. Calculation exhaustive only for P,k=3.
